cards.name: #1: A daily body scrub that calms and hydrates, gentle enough for everyday summer skin
cards.desc:
It took us three years to get our sugar scrub store ready. Summer skin takes the most and shows the most: sun, sweat, salt water, shaving. Most scrubs are too harsh for that, but oat calms while a humectant pulls in hydration. That's why we focused on making a formula that truly nourishes your skin.

\#sugarscrub #cleanbeauty #summerskin

cards.name: #2: This candle became a forever scent
cards.desc:
